description: Here is a description of Figure 1: This pie chart shows the distribution of content types in the DODa. The chart is divided into six categories: Moroccan Names, Semantic Categories, Syntactic Roles, Translated Sentences, Extra + Augmented Data, and Pending Translations. The largest category is Translated Sentences, which accounts for 45,387 entries. The second largest category is Syntactic Roles, with 23,108 entries. The third largest category is Extra + Augmented Data, with 43,000 entries. The fourth largest category is Pending Translations, with 36,000 entries. The fifth largest category is Moroccan Names, with 25,000 entries. The smallest category is Semantic Categories, with 1,245 entries.
